analogy.rationale: Phospholipase inhibitors lack annotated targets and act on lipid-signaling enzymes whose products (arachidonic acid, eicosanoids) are not a dominant transcriptional program in these cell lines, so responses should be weak; the closest listed classes are other lipid-pathway modulators, though even these share only partial downstream overlap.
